definitions.explanation: The native Japanese word for ten, the final element in the {一|ひと}つ, {二|ふた}つ, {三|みっ}つ ... {十|とお} counting sequence. This series stops at ten; from eleven onward, Japanese uses the Sino-Japanese system ({十一|じゅういち}).

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{十|とお}⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十|とお}になった。
⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧、⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えて→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧いって、{十|とお}で⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいになった。
examples.english: Counting one, two, and so on, the box was exactly full at ten.

notes:
Last word in the native counting sequence: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧, ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧, ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧, ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧, ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧, ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧, ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧, ⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧, ⟦{九|ここの}つ→九つ：02902_kokonotsu⟧, {十|とお}. Notice that {十|とお} alone takes no つ suffix.

USAGE:
- For general items, especially with no special counter: ringo o {十|とお}
- For age: {十|とお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ ("turn ten") is a slightly literary alternative to {十歳|じゅっさい}
- After ten, switch to the Sino-Japanese system: ⟦{十一|じゅういち}→十一：00949_juuichi⟧, ⟦{十二|じゅうに}→十二：00952_juuni⟧, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧: ten (Sino-Japanese) — used with most counters ({十冊|じゅっさつ}, ⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧)
- {十歳|じゅっさい}: ten years old — standard expression for age
